LEBLANC", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u213-r0062", "target": "— Что за собачья погода! — сказал он.", "source_sha256": "e60e0f1464023ef5aa6fe05f6494f586d0f84734252cbe19548b18bbfb7a1f40", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u213-r0062", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "8f5c38f4298060b8ff6c006ba2c0ff439a112afc4e49636dce27acf8aec55e58"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u213-r0063", "target": "Потом, запахнув сюртук:", "source_sha256": "162d937275dd78bdb880cec975f95808c614d0b81c4b0f5ef0187e9920238920", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u213-r0063", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "bfcb1de42c35f9a04864214f27c74b4ed7c954688a12ce26903d07f343dce17a"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 8, "chapter": 12, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u213-r0064", "tag": "prose", "text": "— La pelure est trop large. — C’est égal, ajouta-t-il, il a diablement bien fait de me la laisser, le vieux coquin ! Sans cela je n’aurais pas pu sortir et tout aurait encore manqué. À quoi les choses tiennent pourtant !", "sha256": "9b84c8bc90ed266d22da8be7154f42a6ae1fa0f334989f8dc64e0180b6fd3d47", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et, enfonçant la casquette sur ses yeux, il sortit.", "sha256": "a26a68acd456ccb01853aa900f15d0d116bb049c63a3df51a23da6fea6564136", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "À peine avait-il eu le temps de faire quelques pas dehors que la porte se rouvrit et que son profil fauve et intelligent reparut par l’ouverture.", "sha256": "b54c8c1c077de9286acddcfcb0bd593e432690e23f519a4699953fd4d6571094", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’oubliais, dit-il. Tu auras un réchaud de charbon.", "sha256": "fb53f31d4ebc6e7df6816d8b318609e861a161458acba7694327886be9ac255b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il jeta dans le tablier de sa femme la pièce de cinq francs que lui avait laissée le « philanthrope ».", "sha256": "2a6b694a789f1a697cfefff0b9ffd98d0fa54d95c6238f45274497f2a994cd5d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Un réchaud de charbon ? demanda la femme.", "sha256": "6ee2d8a0abd2abee23af9dbc30ee9a0383688019c0b97ef373de441c4ee405c0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0070", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Combien de boisseaux ?", "sha256": "78d0be979f4fce921faec7e0d15ea833584db2eaed46511f8366fc162ce7b72b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Deux bons.", "sha256": "67f54a4c36de047db7c19970e2c136aa9e4b999c27804325436e1f6d453d59f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cela fera trente sous. Avec le reste, j’achèterai de quoi dîner.", "sha256": "6567318de0284bbc8930241c1f0711f5733ed842fb08bbc350dce58c20a60f4a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Diable, non.", "sha256": "e106a2fe5a2d36cbc7b6afa52a54182e90d7eda1fb82ec741100224070b8e1d2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pourquoi ?", "sha256": "4b5154ea331b0a88da96b0d95a9812f8ce55fa954dcfa4511479082dd555da57", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0076", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ne va pas dépenser la pièce-cent-sous.", "sha256": "ca56ab69999ec56043b37172cf8d6e69149522eb4c1ec29b152752d4100ddcdd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0077", "tag": "prose", "text": "tag": "prose", "text": "— Parce que j’aurai quelque chose à acheter de mon côté.", "sha256": "3bc5a6bb015f59fefac8b9ae9f461158d8cc2d988830a1fb1460ce22591bae48", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0079", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi ?", "sha256": "61a0fac8ae488c6bc653f1215cdda5ca31b778598be9273b7ab3b579855004d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0080", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quelque chose.", "sha256": "c982acbffea0894e5ca8f5ccca8c34585d42cbd09b6297b2ab25ae751b04edfe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0081", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Combien te faudra-t-il ?", "sha256": "0baf2f9301d0730f9b971ba300717329bfc73a5465abf045f1adf2cdb2553e65", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0082", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où y a-t-il un quincaillier par ici ?", "sha256": "e6dfbff50c6a28a2142b3b926dae4f74c1cfc55a5b90bfa66f48f0b6953fe68b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0083", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Rue Mouffetard.", "sha256": "f70cfd4cc4f6ef3bf66c1dbb0daa61263bc396d371a29e72594dd167a2e493f1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0084", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! oui, au coin d’une rue ; je vois la boutique.", "sha256": "e80981a66e831d84913f72e294c0bb11a1ff62e95cff1231204e530c10dc440d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0085", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais dis-moi donc combien il te faudra pour ce que tu as à acheter ?", "sha256": "5e0d2636f360ef94c025bd073e3b033ecff60d1fb1b58c1500a528aaa90ab9d1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0086", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cinquante sous-trois francs.", "sha256": "688eb951e4537569c62bd4b397fe22b78367e0a83f6a8816457336e558fe9ffa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0087", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il ne restera pas gras pour le dîner.", "sha256": "f4cbefcff1eb951e8a5b231a4054633263292b04b625af670a086f2879611f91", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0088", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Aujourd’hui il ne s’agit pas de manger. Il y a mieux à faire.", "sha256": "dd4eb74549b5d058d17eed87f35fcd1f807b980cbfcd08421b3d939bb25fc487", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0089", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ça suffit, mon bijou.", "sha256": "47a23f09db8f09493f58355d68eb2cd171e24692071d947ed1a7a823206aede6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0090", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sur ce mot de sa femme, Jondrette referma la porte, et cette fois Marius entendit son pas s’éloigner dans le corridor de la masure et descendre rapidement l’escalier.", "sha256": "c311c940c006dc025f50c4d23b98b173581b3fe1c03517eb8cf359b17bf5c3a8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u213-r0091", "tag": "prose", "text": "Une heure sonnait en cet instant à Saint-Médard.", "sha256": "f2a1977b9b2a2ad753408cf150231229651ebce79037af13d07a73b4e50cf078", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
